exclusion_reason: The preservation catalog is implemented as an append-only, provenance-carrying record set: appending an entry whose id already exists with different content is refused, an identical re-append is a no-op, and the export is deterministic byte-stable and personal-data-free (a PII hit refuses the export). The benchmark stays red because playing a preserved title needs the absent browser game runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the chain refuses mutation, the export reproduces byte-stably, and the personal-data audit holds.
active_gate_evidence: test/library.test.mjs asserts mutation of an existing id is refused, duplicates no-op, the export hash and body are identical across runs, and a record carrying an email refuses the export.
procedure: Append the declared entry set and attempt a mutation.
Audit the export for personal data.
